import MDAnalysis as mda
import numpy as np
from MDAnalysis.analysis.msd import EinsteinMSD

# Load trajectory
u = mda.Universe('sio2.data', 'dump.lammpstrj', format='LAMMPSDUMP')

# Calculate MSD
msd = EinsteinMSD(u, select='all')
msd.run()

# Get MSD data
time = msd.results.times
msd_data = msd.results.timeseries

# Skip first 500 ps (500,000 steps)
skip_frames = 500
msd_data = msd_data[skip_frames:]

# Find melting point by detecting sudden jump in MSD
diff = np.diff(msd_data)
threshold = np.mean(diff) + 2*np.std(diff)
melting_frame = np.where(diff > threshold)[0][0] + skip_frames

# Calculate diffusion constant in molten state
# D = MSD/(6*t) in the long-time limit
molten_msd = msd_data[melting_frame:]
molten_time = time[melting_frame:]
D = (molten_msd[-1] - molten_msd[0])/(6*(molten_time[-1] - molten_time[0]))

# Convert to m²/s (LAMMPS metal units: Å²/ps to m²/s)
D_SI = D * 1e-4

print(f"{D_SI:.6e}")
print('Hello world')

import MDAnalysis as mda
import numpy as np
from MDAnalysis.analysis import msd

# Load trajectory
u = mda.Universe('sio2.data', 'traj.lammpstrj', format='LAMMPSDUMP')

# Calculate MSD
msd_analyzer = msd.EinsteinMSD(u, select='all', msd_type='xyz')
msd_analyzer.run()

# Get MSD data
times = msd_analyzer.times
msds = msd_analyzer.results.timeseries

# Skip first 500 ps (500,000 steps = 500 frames at 1000 step intervals)
start_idx = 500
msds = msds[start_idx:]
times = times[start_idx:]

# Find melting point (sudden jump in MSD)
msd_diff = np.diff(msds)
melting_idx = np.where(msd_diff > np.mean(msd_diff) + 2*np.std(msd_diff))[0][0]

# Calculate diffusion constant after melting
# D = MSD/(6*t) in the liquid phase
liquid_times = times[melting_idx:] - times[melting_idx]
liquid_msds = msds[melting_idx:]
    
# Fit MSD vs time to get diffusion constant
# Convert to m²/s (LAMMPS metal units: time in ps, distance in Å)
slope, _ = np.polyfit(liquid_times, liquid_msds, 1)
D = slope / 6.0 * 1e-4  # Convert from Å²/ps to m²/s

print(f"{D:.6e}")

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import MDAnalysis as mda
import numpy as np
from MDAnalysis.analysis.msd import EinsteinMSD

# Load trajectory
u = mda.Universe('sio2.data', 'traj.lammpstrj', format='LAMMPSDUMP')

# Calculate MSD
msd = EinsteinMSD(u, select='all')
msd.run()

# Get MSD data
time = msd.results.times  # in ps
msd_values = msd.results.timeseries

# Skip first 500 ps
skip_frames = int(500 / (time[1] - time[0]))
msd_values = msd_values[skip_frames:]
time = time[skip_frames:]

# Find melting point by detecting sudden jump in MSD
msd_diff = np.diff(msd_values)
melting_idx = np.where(msd_diff > np.mean(msd_diff) + 2*np.std(msd_diff))[0][0]
melting_time = time[melting_idx]

# Calculate diffusion constant in molten state
# D = MSD/(6*t) in the long-time limit
molten_msd = msd_values[melting_idx:]
molten_time = time[melting_idx:]
D = (molten_msd[-1] - molten_msd[0]) / (6 * (molten_time[-1] - molten_time[0]))

# Convert D to m²/s (from Å²/ps)
D_si = D * 1e-4  # Å²/ps to m²/s

print(f"{D_si:.6e}")

import MDAnalysis as mda
import numpy as np
from MDAnalysis.analysis import msd

# Load trajectory
u = mda.Universe('Al.data', 'traj.lammpstrj', format='LAMMPSDUMP')

# Calculate MSD
msd_analyzer = msd.EinsteinMSD(u, select='all', msd_type='xyz')
msd_analyzer.run()

# Get MSD data
time = msd_analyzer.times
msd_values = msd_analyzer.results.timeseries

# Skip first 50ps (50,000 timesteps)
skip_frames = 50  # Since we dump every 100 steps, 50 frames = 50ps
time = time[skip_frames:]
msd_values = msd_values[skip_frames:]

# Find melting point by detecting sudden jump in MSD
msd_diff = np.diff(msd_values)
melting_frame = np.where(msd_diff > np.mean(msd_diff) + 2*np.std(msd_diff))[0][0] + skip_frames

# Calculate diffusion constant in molten state (after melting)
# D = MSD/(6*t) in 3D
molten_msd = msd_values[melting_frame-skip_frames:]
molten_time = time[melting_frame-skip_frames:]
D = np.mean(molten_msd/(6*molten_time))

# Convert from Å²/ps to m²/s
D_SI = D * 1e-4  # Convert from Å²/ps to m²/s

print(f"{D_SI:.6e}")

arguments.content:
import MDAnalysis as mda
import numpy as np
from MDAnalysis.analysis.msd import EinsteinMSD

# Load trajectory
u = mda.Universe('Si.data', 'traj.lammpstrj', format='LAMMPSDUMP')

# Calculate MSD
msd = EinsteinMSD(u, select='all', msd_type='xyz')
msd.run()

# Get MSD data
time = msd.results.times  # in ps
msd_values = msd.results.timeseries  # in Å²

# Convert time to ps (from timesteps)
dt = 0.001  # ps
time = time * dt

# Skip first 50 ps
start_idx = int(50/dt)
time = time[start_idx:]
msd_values = msd_values[start_idx:]

# Find melting point by detecting sudden jump in MSD
window = 10
msd_gradient = np.gradient(msd_values, window)
melting_idx = np.where(msd_gradient > np.mean(msd_gradient) + 2*np.std(msd_gradient))[0][0]
melting_time = time[melting_idx]

# Calculate diffusion constant in molten state
# D = MSD/(6*t) in the liquid phase
# Convert from Å²/ps to m²/s
molten_msd = msd_values[melting_idx:]
molten_time = time[melting_idx:] - time[melting_idx]
D = np.mean(molten_msd/(6*molten_time)) * 1e-4  # Convert Å²/ps to m²/s

print(f"{D:.6e}")
